hypothesis: Add measured interventions from missing HepG2/Jurkat contexts and RPE1; test new biological information rather than another decoder or blend of the same legacy five-source bank.
source_filter: Measured competition genes, target>=30 cells and reference>=400; positive finite control mean; source control expression>=5CPM on released axis; actual source FDR<.05 and finite nonzero LFC with concordant Ueffect sign. Non-significance/absent features are abstention, never credible biological zero. Own target is masked from predicted downstream effects.
source_effect: Use released linear normalized means and measured LFC, clipped +/-3; knockdown rescale0.9/max(observed suppression,0.35), bounded0.8..1.8, if own evidence exists; otherwise no additional dose rescaling. Query-source pairwise-valid nonpanel Spearman on the shared released axis weights contexts exp(4*(rho-maxrho)). Total prior weights Nadig1 split across2contexts, RPE1/Replogle1; no independence claim for two Nadig contexts.
routed: Weighted mean of valid measured effects. Confidence=min(ncells/100,1)*min(abs(Ueffect)/.2,1). Source weight includes this confidence. Add0.25*pooled-confidence*clip(newLFC-V66,-1,1); own zero. Coordinates with no measured evidence unchanged.
conserved: Same proposal but requires same-direction significant evidence in RPE1 and at least one Nadig context. The opposite direction never counts as an independent vote for zero.
identity_guard: Apply unchanged V63 80% identity-margin guard around the fold-specific V66 predictions using query bulk proportions and excluding all panel genes, not around V24; no query treated values.
negative: Derange supported source target rows cyclically before recipient correction, preserving own mask and honest norm differences. Refit no model against recipient treatment labels.
development: Reuse655-pair public mean truth bank, whole H1/Orion/CD4 recipient exclusion. Compare against fold-specific V66; macro study profile error, target-identification PDS and cell-mean LFC. Frozen arm selection among candidates with profile ratio<=.995, worst-study<=1.03, PDS>=baseline-.005, lower profile error than target derangement. Primary routed25 is independently tested on donor even if development rejects all arms; such test cannot waive development failure.

fresh_donor.selection: ALL metadata targets>=400, before treatment expression; use matched-control-supported targets only and record exclusions by metadata. No outcome-based target choice.
fresh_donor.excluded_response_family: Entire CD4, including merged donor summaries; Jurkat is allowed distinct-study T lineage.
fresh_donor.task: Fresh donor, previously seen study; not a wholly independent study, final-test proxy or a perfectly blind target set.
fresh_donor.fit_controls: Within-lane deterministic half split of NTCs; reference distinct half; template400 selected by lane/depth only; actual400 distinct cells per target when available. Recipient treatment cannot fit, select or calibrate any deployable model.
fresh_donor.counts: V66, fixed primary routed25, its derangement; any different dev-selected arm is additional only if eligible. Use unchanged residual10 and identical template/depth/seed for all arms. Independent tied-rank/BH/DE/PDS audits; source exclusion audit. Frozen second seed620000 after first-case cohort fit, never tune on donor.
fresh_donor.guards: Both mean development and fresh donor required for recommending a new model: profile ratio<=1, no metric materially worse (PDS-.005,FID-.002,REACH-.005,JAC-.0005,NMAE+1%), at least3 of6 favorable; beat deranged response on profile and FID or JAC. Missing metric stays unavailable; no complete-six-metric claim without all six.
fresh_donor.oracle: If frozen primary fails fresh donor, assess split-half target reproducibility and a clearly labeled mean-oracle using disjoint treated halves. Diagnostics never become inference inputs and cannot select a new candidate.
